forum.title: STM32WB5MMGH6 - pins on CubeMX vs datasheet
forum.best_answer_content:
When I have a look at <https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/stm32wb5mmg.pdf> there is a not on page 7:

“PB0 and PB1 are only available for revision X parts.”

Maybe this helps...
forum.content_text: Pins 43 (PB1) and 44 (PB0) on the STM32WB5MMG Datasheet are listed at NC (no connection). In CubeMx these pins are available to use. I would like to confirm which is correct for the Bluetooth module LGA86 STM32WB5MMG.
